name: plugin-rules
description: Load the rules/ folders that installed Claude Code plugins ship (Claude, Cursor .mdc and Antigravity formats), with path scoping.

extraDirs.title: Extra rule directories
extraDirs.description: Comma-separated directories with rule files (for example a team standards checkout). Relative paths are resolved against the project.

disabledPlugins.title: Plugins to skip
disabledPlugins.description: Comma-separated plugin names (the part before @) whose rules must not load.
